title: Multi-turn prompt-cache persistence and epoch boundary verification
description: 8-turn interactive development workload measuring prompt cache hit rates, epoch marker boundaries, and hysteresis gating.

turns.name: Project Ingestion
turns.user_prompt: Analyze the codebase architecture and list all core subsystems in docs/GUIDE.md.
turns.expected_behavior: Ingests system prompt, developer rules, and tool definitions. Establishes initial stable prefix.

turns.name: Interface Inspection
turns.user_prompt: What are the exact method signatures defined in core/src/prompt_cache.rs?
turns.expected_behavior: Appends brief user message and tool call. Reads entire previous turn from prompt cache.

turns.name: Method Deep Dive
turns.user_prompt: Explain how plan_prompt_cache places breakpoints on the frozen epoch boundary.
turns.expected_behavior: Appends analysis. Continues prefix cache hit.

turns.name: Context Pressure Surge
turns.user_prompt: Run extensive multi-file searches across all crates to find every usage of ContextPruner and compile output logs.
turns.expected_behavior: Produces high tool output volume, pushing window occupancy past the 30% trigger threshold (~80k tokens).

turns.name: Post-Prune Follow-Up
turns.user_prompt: Summarize the findings and verify whether any errors were logged during the search.
turns.expected_behavior: Ace Pruning Pass 1 runs. Seals Epoch 1 with marker. Request hits cache on Epoch 1 boundary instead of dropping to zero.

turns.name: Targeted Code Modification
turns.user_prompt: Draft a patch in core/src/context_pruner.rs to refine the hysteresis cooling condition.
turns.expected_behavior: Appends patch diff. Stable cache hit over Epoch 1 prefix.

turns.name: Second Context Pressure Cycle
turns.user_prompt: Run full test suite outputs and trace analysis on all test cases.
turns.expected_behavior: Pushes context back to 30% trigger. Ace Prune Cycle 2 runs and seals Epoch 2.

turns.name: Final Acceptance Check
turns.user_prompt: Review all completed changes and confirm that no invariants were violated.
turns.expected_behavior: Final summary turn. Hits cache on Epoch 2 prefix with high reuse.
